the development of a facile and ecofriendly approach to fabricate water soluble CIZS/Zns QDs and the application in Cu2+ detection via cation exchange.

we developed the facile synthesis of CIZS QDs, which are highly water soluble and have tunable emission from green to red.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
aqueous synthesis is a facile and effective way to synthesize water soluble CIZS/Zns QDs with tunable emission, which are promising for Cu2+ sensing.

the water soluble CIZS/Zns QDs with tunable emission can serve as the template for mild and rapid cations exchange and the resulting CIZS/ZS QDs can be used as a fluorescent sensor for Cu 2+ detection.
the CIZS QDs are promising for the development of novel fluorescent sensors and the cation exchange is a facile method for the detection of heavy metal ions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the aqueous synthesis of CIZS QDs is a promising method to fabricate high quality QDs with tunable emission.
the CIZS QDs are a promising platform for developing fluorescent sensor for Cu(II), and the facile synthesis of the CIZQDs provides a new avenue for the synthesis of water soluble non cadmium QDs.

the CIZS QDs can be used as the templates for cation exchange and the resultant CIZS/Zns QDs are highly sensitive for Cu2+ with high selectivity and low detection limit, which can be extended to other metal ions sensing.
